components.basis: Three on-route resolution refutations are drawn as DAGs from their input clauses to the empty clause. The propositional one is {P,Q},{~P,R},{~R},{~Q,R} -> {~P},{~Q} -> {Q} -> empty; {~R} feeds two merges, so it is a DAG and not a tree. The first-order one is C1..C4 -> C5 -> C6 -> C7 = empty, and the retained one is C1..C3 -> C4 -> empty. All three rendered correctly in a standalone build.

Each inference in fig:p02-w02-p02-018-fol-dag carries the rule name, the resolved literal pair A, ~B with their parent clauses, and the most general unifier: theta1 = {x->y}, theta2 = {y->a}, and theta3 = id for the ground step. The lemma and its written annex proof verify each unifier and resolvent. The retained figure labels both inferences 'Resolution' and shows the nonground MGU {x->a}. The propositional DAG labels each merge with its pivot. The annotations are present and legible; defect_observations records one overprint.
